project.name: gu-sakkyoku.github.io
project.productType: Japanese university music club / album and lyrics site

must: Preserve existing URLs and the contents of 2024/2025 album and lyrics pages; visual redesign is authorized
Keep the compact 64px/72px header and 44px touch targets
Use the supplied album artwork and official transparent logo
Keep download authorization and R2 storage unchanged
avoid: Leaking album themes into the home page, 2026, or downloads
Uniform rounded cards, glow backgrounds, and decorative-only controls

decisions: 2026-10-26: User selected space for Horoscope and rainbow for Nijiiro memory.

2026-10-26: User rejected invented catchphrases and a generic AI appearance. Use record-sleeve / booklet compositions, original artwork, factual information, ruled navigation, and different layouts for the two albums.

2026-10-26: User requested more excitement and no decorative section numbers. Add a real two-artwork gallery, space artwork backdrop, seven-color arch and printed-color typography. Use only short, one-time entrance motion; honor reduced-motion.

2026-10-26: User requested more motion including 2026. Add progressive scroll reveals, bounded artwork/background depth, pointer-only jacket tilt and the existing 2026 title/CD/bubble choreography. Original lyrics and download forms remain outside the motion scope. All content is visible without JavaScript; reduced-motion cancels active motion.

Motion reference: https://eveofficial-underblue.com/ (artwork layering and scroll reveals). Implement locally with existing Framer Motion and native browser animation APIs; no copied vendor script or extra dependency.

2026-10-26: User requested more deliberate typography. Horoscope uses Orbitron 600, Nijiiro uses Mochiy Pop One plus Fugaz One, and Tansan Yohou uses Mochiy Pop One. Title-only font files are self-hosted (3964 bytes total) with OFL licenses; body/credits/lyrics reuse existing full fonts. See docs/album-typography.md.
Album themes are scoped by route layouts and src/app/album-worlds.css; original lyric text and line breaks are preserved.
